verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs support fast onboarding via Checkout, Payment Links (no-code), and sandbox testing, and one HN commenter reports being 'up and running and accepting recurring payments in less than an hour' (stripe-comm-9). However, other community reports describe account denials or business restrictions that blocked payment acceptance entirely (stripe-comm-1, stripe-comm-4), showing the 'within a day' promise doesn't hold universally.
